en.title: World No.1 Go player Shin Jin-seo defeats AI KataGo in two-point handicap match
en.hook: The reigning world champion overcomes a two-point handicap to beat the AI KataGo, highlighting the limits of current AI in creative play
key_takeaways: Shin Jin-seo, the current world No.1 Go player, beats AI KataGo despite a two-point handicap
The match underscores that AI still lacks the strategic depth and creativity of top human players
Shin's victory is attributed to his long-term strategic planning and reading ability

zh.title: 世界第一棋手申真-seo在两目让中击败AI KataGo
zh.hook: 世界冠军申真-seo以两目让克服劣势击败AI KataGo，展现了当前AI在创造性下的局限性
key_takeaways: 世界第一棋手申真-seo在两目让中击败AI KataGo
这场比赛表明，AI在战略深度和创造性方面仍无法超越顶尖人类玩家
申真-seo的胜利归功于其长期战略规划和棋路阅读能力
